extracted.name: Boiled Potatoes with Chives
extracted.description: These boiled potatoes are easy to make with small red potatoes or new potatoes, butter, and chives for a delicious side that pairs well with any meal.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds very small red potatoes, scrubbed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain and let sit until cool enough to handle, 1 to 2 minutes.
Cut potatoes in half and place into a serving bowl.
Add butter, chives, salt, and pepper; toss until butter melts and potatoes are well coated.
